_finding: The token page draws the B20 line from the passport's top-level block and ages it by the server's age plus performance.now(), never the visitor's clock; the line and the notes expire by that rule (the stress reviews of B20).

mutations.name: an open line never expires
mutations.expect: FAIL rendered: open a minute later is open; an hour later the same line is unknown

mutations.name: the line is drawn from the price row
mutations.expect: FAIL the token page has words for both notes, and draws the line from the top-level block

mutations.name: the B20 notes never expire
mutations.expect: FAIL rendered an hour later: no pause note

mutations.name: the line ages by the visitor's clock
mutations.find: const ageMs = base == null ? null : base + Math.max(0, elapsedMs || 0)
mutations.replace: const ageMs = Number.isFinite(Date.parse(t.checked_at)) ? Date.now() - Date.parse(t.checked_at) : null
mutations.expect: FAIL the page reads no wall clock for the line

mutations.name: the line ages from the rounded age
mutations.expect: FAIL the page ages the line from the server
